title: SaaS landing page
description: Build a single-page SaaS landing page for a fictional developer tool. Distinct hero, feature grid, pricing, footer. Must avoid generic Lorem layouts.
prompt: Create a landing page for 'Driftlight' — a tiny observability tool for Bun servers. Include a hero, three-feature grid, pricing, and a footer. The brand voice is warm-technical; avoid the usual purple-gradient SaaS look.

rubric.label: Hero has a distinctive composition, not a stock hero
rubric.guidance: Look for a non-default layout (split, asymmetric, type-driven).

rubric.label: Three features rendered as a coherent grid
rubric.guidance: Items share visual rhythm, not random icon + text cards.

rubric.label: Pricing section with three tiers
rubric.guidance: Tier comparison legible at a glance.

rubric.label: Footer present with at least nav + small print
Brand voice reads warm-technical, not generic SaaS
rubric.guidance: Read aloud: does it sound human?
